Hi, 
sorry for the late reply, I missed your post over the holidays. The warning is produced by Exiftool and can usually be ignored. It has to do with the metadata structure in the images, and I even see that in the sample data included in camtrapR. 
Does it cause any problems? If not and the output of timeShiftImages is correct I think you can safely ignore it. 
Best,
Jürgen
